title: Book 7: The Nine-Figure Refusal & The Jessica Miller Center (2018–2019)
description: In September 2018, The Stardust Engine flies into Los Angeles, dismantles Omni-Global Media's $150 million leveraged buyout pitch with Clause 88 after Jameson Frost tries to butcher Cassidy's 'Ad Astra,' acquires the Burbank master-tape archive out of bankruptcy, and establishes The Jessica Miller Center, LLC on Floors 38–40 of 2000 Avenue of the Stars in Century City with twins Jessica and Justin Miller at the helm.
